landing.heroTitle: Run your housing society from one place.
landing.heroBody: Parisar brings notices, complaints, polls, amenity bookings, visitors and your resident directory into one app for the committee and every resident.
landing.heroNote: We set up your society with you on a call. Residents then join with your society code.
landing.previewLabel: Example of a resident's home screen
landing.previewNotice: Water tank cleaning on Sunday, 10 am
landing.benefitsLead: Less chasing on group chats, and a clear record of what was decided and done.
landing.b1Body: Notices, complaints, bookings and polls stop getting lost in group chats. Everyone knows where to look.
landing.b2Body: Each notice, complaint and approval shows who did it, for which flat, and when.
landing.b3Body: Every screen works in English, हिन्दी and मराठी. Each resident picks their own.
landing.b4Title: Only your society sees your data
landing.b4Body: Records are tied to your society in the database, and the committee verifies who joins.
landing.featuresLead: We switch on the modules your society needs when we set it up.
landing.fNoticesBody: Post a notice once and it reaches every flat.
landing.fComplaintsBody: Residents raise an issue with a photo, and the committee tracks it until it is closed.
landing.fPollsBody: Ask the society a question and see the count as votes come in.
landing.fBookingsBody: Book the clubhouse or another amenity, with approval from the committee.
landing.fVisitorsBody: Guards log visitors at the gate and residents approve them.
landing.fSosBody: Raise an emergency alert to residents, the committee or the guards.
landing.fDirectoryBody: Residents by wing and flat, with phone numbers kept private.
landing.fCommunityBody: Society-wide posts, questions and replies that stay inside your society.
landing.fStaffBody: Society staff and local help contacts in one list.
landing.fCalendarBody: Water shutdowns, lift maintenance and other schedules everyone can see.
landing.fFlatNoticesBody: Record a warning, fine or notice against a flat, with who issued it and when.
landing.howLead: You don't set anything up alone. We do the first part with you on a call.
landing.s1Body: Your society's name, the mobile numbers of the people who will manage it, and a good time to call.
landing.s2Body: We confirm the details and register your society on Parisar.
landing.s3Body: Each person you listed signs in with their own mobile number, then adds wings, floors and flats.
landing.s4Body: Share your society code. Residents join, and the committee verifies them.
landing.q1: Who can manage our society on Parisar?
landing.a1: Anyone your society chooses, not only the chairman. Give us their mobile numbers when you connect with us. Each person signs in with their own number.
landing.q2: Does Parisar collect maintenance or other payments?
landing.a2: No. Parisar does not handle money. Collections stay in your society's own accounts.
landing.q3: Can another society see our data?
landing.a3: No. Every record is tied to your society in the database, not just hidden on screen.
landing.a4: English, हिन्दी and मराठी. Each resident chooses their own language.
landing.q5: What happens after I send the form?
landing.a5: You get a request ID straight away. We call you at the time you chose, register your society, and help your committee sign in. You can check the status any time with the request ID and your mobile number.
landing.ctaBody: Send us your details and we'll call you at a time that suits you.
